name: Opium
summary: Opium is a naturally occurring analgesic harvested as a latex from ripe Papaver somniferum (opium poppy) pods. The sap of the poppy plant primarily contains codeine and morphine with the amounts varying by plant, which can be made into a tea and consumed raw, or further processed.
advisory: Avoid: The drug has a high rate of overdoses and it is strongly recommended against using foil to smoke it.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Opium's main psychoactive alkaloids, primarily morphine, act on μ-opioid receptors, causing analgesia, with long-term use leading to tolerance and dependence.

uses.text: Opium was widely used for food, medicine, ritual, and as a painkiller throughout ancient civilizations including Greece, Egypt, and Islamic societies up to medieval times.

zhOther: 大煙, 阿芙蓉, 公班土, 福壽如意膏
summaryZh: 鴉片（英語：opium）是一種毒品，當作為藥品時譯為意義較中性的阿片，是從尚未成熟的罌粟果里取出的乳狀液體，乾燥後變成淡黃色或棕色固體，味苦。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, nausea, vomiting, itching and constipation, and it slows breathing. An overdose can stop breathing altogether. The strength of raw opium varies a great deal, and regular use leads to tolerance, dependence and a hard withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、噁心、嘔吐、搔癢與便祕，並抑制呼吸，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。生鴉片的強度差異極大，規律使用會造成耐受性、依賴，以及難受的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、恶心、呕吐、搔痒与便秘，并抑制呼吸，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。生鸦片的强度差异极大，规律使用会造成耐受性、依赖，以及难受的戒断反应。

fact.en: Opium is the dried latex of the poppy seed pod, scored by hand so the sap oozes out. Clay tablets show the Sumerians were harvesting it more than four thousand years ago.
fact.zh: 鴉片是罌粟果實的乾燥乳膠，人們以刀劃開果實讓汁液滲出。泥板文獻顯示蘇美人在四千多年前就已採收鴉片。
fact.zhHans: 鸦片是罂粟果实的干燥乳胶，人们以刀划开果实让汁液渗出。泥板文献显示苏美人在四千多年前就已采收鸦片。
